michael: St. Michael the Archangel, defend us in battle. Be our protection against the wickedness and snares of the devil. May God rebuke him, we humbly pray; and do thou, O Prince of the heavenly host, by the power of God, cast into hell Satan and all the evil spirits who prowl about the world seeking the ruin of souls. Amen.
pio: St. Padre Pio, faithful son of St. Francis, teach me to trust Jesus completely and to offer my sufferings in union with His. Watch over this channel and our stream family, and help me to pray, hope, and not worry. Amen.
joan: St. Joan of Arc, brave and faithful servant of God, obtain for me courage, honesty, and faithfulness. Help me stand firm against every enemy without hatred, and to finish this novena strong. Amen.

2026-10-24.why: Today's optional memorial (General Roman Calendar). A bishop, missionary preacher and founder of a religious publishing house, he spread the faith through the printed word, much as this channel tries to do online.
2026-10-24.prayer: St. Anthony Mary Claret, tireless preacher and lover of Mary's Immaculate Heart, pray that this channel may carry the Gospel to many, and that we may be zealous, humble and patient in serving souls. Amen.

2026-10-25.why: Sunday with no memorial, so we chose a saint matched to our intentions: Raphael, whose name means “God heals,” guided Tobias to his wife Sarah (Tobit 5–8), so he is asked to help with healing and future spouses.
2026-10-25.prayer: St. Raphael, medicine of God, as you led Tobias safely and brought him to Sarah, guide us to our vocations, protect our future spouses and families, and bring healing to the sick we pray for. Amen.

2026-10-26.why: No memorial in the US calendar today. Monica prayed for years for her son Augustine's conversion (Confessions), so she is a patron of perseverance and of prayer for those far from God.
2026-10-26.prayer: St. Monica, patient mother of St. Augustine, teach us to keep praying when answers are slow, and pray with us for all who are far from God, that they may come home to Jesus. Amen.

2026-10-27.why: No memorial in the US calendar today. Joseph the Worker, the carpenter of Nazareth, is the Church's patron of workers and of families, which matches our prayer for a good, steady job.
2026-10-27.prayer: St. Joseph, faithful worker and guardian of the Holy Family, obtain for me good and steady work, the grace to do it well for God's glory, and protection for our families. Amen.

2026-10-28.why: Today's feast (General Roman Calendar). St. Jude is invoked for hopeless cases, which matches our prayer for all who are despairing or in need of hope.
2026-10-28.prayer: Holy Apostles Simon and Jude, who carried the name of Jesus to the nations, pray for all who are despairing or in need of hope, and help us to share the faith boldly and with love. Amen.

2026-10-29.why: No memorial in the US calendar today. Dymphna, an Irish virgin and martyr venerated at Geel, is the traditional patron of people with mental and nervous afflictions, which matches our prayer for healing and for those who are suffering.
2026-10-29.prayer: St. Dymphna, pure and courageous martyr, pray for all who suffer in mind and heart, for those who struggle with anxiety or sadness, and for my own healing, that we may find peace in Jesus. Amen.

2026-10-30.why: No memorial in the US calendar today. Kolbe used the press and radio of his day to spread devotion to Mary, and he gave his life for another prisoner at Auschwitz, so he is a fitting patron for this channel.
2026-10-30.prayer: St. Maximilian Kolbe, knight of the Immaculata, you used every means of your time to bring souls to Jesus through Mary. Pray that this channel may do the same, and that we may love even to the point of sacrifice. Amen.

2026-10-31.why: No obligatory memorial in the US calendar today (the vigil of All Saints). Francis de Sales, Doctor of the Church and patron of writers, won back opponents through gentleness and patient explanation, which matches our prayer for enemies and those who speak against us.
2026-10-31.prayer: St. Francis de Sales, gentle Doctor of the Church, teach us to speak the truth with charity, to answer those who oppose us without hatred, and to grow in patience and humility. Amen.

2026-11-01.why: Solemnity of All Saints (General Roman Calendar): we honor every saint in heaven, known and unknown, and ask them all to pray for us.
2026-11-01.prayer: All you holy men and women, saints of God, who now see Him face to face, pray for us. Help us to run the race to the end, to love Jesus above all, and to join you one day in the joy of heaven. Amen.

2026-11-02.saint: All Souls (The Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed)
2026-11-02.why: Today's commemoration (USCCB calendar). The Church prays for the souls in purgatory, which fits the intentions we carry for the suffering and for the far from God.
2026-11-02.prayer: Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord, and let perpetual light shine upon them. May they rest in peace. Amen. (Traditional Requiem aeternam.)

2026-11-03.why: Optional memorial on today's USCCB calendar. A Dominican lay brother of Lima, known for humility and for caring for the sick and the poor, he is a good friend for our prayer for the sick and for humble, steady work.
2026-11-03.prayer: St. Martin de Porres, humble brother who served the sick and the poor with gentle charity, pray for us, that we may serve everyone with the same humility and love. Amen.

2026-11-04.why: Memorial on today's USCCB calendar. The cardinal archbishop of Milan who carried out the reforms of the Council of Trent, taught the catechism, and stayed to nurse the sick during the plague of 1576, a good patron for our prayers for the sick and for the renewal of the Church.
2026-11-04.prayer: St. Charles Borromeo, faithful shepherd who reformed your flock and did not abandon the sick in time of plague, pray for us, that we may love the Church, serve the suffering, and persevere in holiness. Amen.

2026-11-05.why: No memorial in the US calendar today (Thursday of the 31st Week in Ordinary Time). Camillus, a soldier whose gambling addiction cost him everything, converted and founded an order to nurse the sick, so he is a fitting patron for our prayers for the sick and for all who struggle with addiction.
2026-11-05.prayer: St. Camillus de Lellis, once lost to gambling and then given wholly to the service of the sick, pray for us, that we may be freed from every chain, care for the suffering as Christ cares for us, and persevere to the end. Amen.

2026-11-09.why: Today the Church keeps the feast of the Dedication of the Lateran Basilica, the cathedral of the Bishop of Rome and the mother church of all churches in the world. The readings show living water from the temple and Christ cleansing His Father's house, so we pray for the Church in Rome and for every parish that shelters us.
2026-11-09.prayer: Lord Jesus, living Temple and cornerstone, bless Your Church gathered under the Lateran and in every parish. Make us living stones, built on You, and cleanse whatever in us clutters the house of prayer. Amen.

2026-11-10.why: Pope and Doctor of the Church. Leo defended the true faith about Christ at Chalcedon and shepherded Rome through invasion with courage and preaching. A fitting patron when we ask for clear teaching and brave pastors.
2026-11-10.prayer: St. Leo the Great, fearless shepherd and teacher of the Incarnation, pray for our Holy Father, our bishops, and for us, that we may hold fast to the truth about Jesus and speak it with charity. Amen.

2026-11-11.why: Soldier who became a bishop; famous for cutting his cloak in half for a beggar and then seeing Christ in a dream. Patron of charity and of those who leave the world's ranks for the Gospel.
2026-11-11.prayer: St. Martin of Tours, who saw Christ in the poor man you clothed, teach us to share what we have and to follow Jesus without fear. Amen.

2026-11-12.why: Bishop and martyr who worked for the unity of Christians under the Chair of Peter and gave his life for that unity. We ask his prayers for reunion in truth and charity.
2026-11-12.prayer: St. Josaphat, martyr for the unity of the Church, pray that all who love Christ may be one, as He prayed, and that we may love the truth without bitterness. Amen.
